name: cogneris-api-examples
description: Runnable Cogneris API examples generated from OpenAPI

scripts.test:workflows: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with PyYAML==6.0.3 python -m unittest tests.test_sdk_workflows tests.test_sdk_release -v
scripts.verify:sdks: npm run check:sdks && npm run test:sdk:typescript && npm run test:sdk:python
scripts.test: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with PyYAML==6.0.3 --with 'httpx>=0.23,<0.29' --with 'attrs>=22.2' --with 'python-dateutil>=2.8,<3' python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
